note: XVII fill shots for the study stretch (Ian, 17 Nov: "everything is happening in the same location").
style: A cinematic Romantic oil painting of 1893 in the manner of the reference: academic realism, atmospheric haze, cool blue dusk and moonlight against warm amber window light, a wide establishing view, rich painterly brushwork. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Exterior, the asylum at Purfleet on a grey late-September afternoon in 1893, seen from far across the wet lawn: the long Georgian front, tall windows, one ground-floor window lit warm, rooks circling the chimneys, dripping elms. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.
Close view from inside: rain running down a tall study window pane in 1893, the blurred grey garden and elms beyond, a brass lamp and the edge of a phonograph horn dark against the glass.

Exterior, high view over the slate roofs and tall chimneys of the asylum at dusk, smoke drifting, rooks settling in the bare elms, and beyond the high wall the dark gabled roofs of the old house Carfax among trees. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior at dusk: looking up at a tall landing window of the asylum, candlelight moving behind the glass as two small figures climb the stair inside, ivy and brick around the window. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior, the Thames marshes near Purfleet at twilight, 1893: a tidal creek reflecting a pale sky, a moored barge, the dark asylum among its trees on the low rise, its windows beginning to glow. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior, the asylum front at evening, 1893: an attendant small on a ladder lighting the gas lamp by the porch, the sky deep blue, windows glowing gold, the gravel drive shining with rain. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior at night: the high old wall between the asylum garden and Carfax, moonlight on the wet bricks, a tangle of bare trees above it, and through a gap the black shape of the old chapel. No people.

Exterior at night from the garden: the asylum dark except two lit windows, the study below and a small sitting-room above, rain falling through the lamplight, the moon behind cloud. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.
